glosses: one of the three original tribes of Rome
one of the twelve tribes of Israel
tribe, subculture (portion of a culture distinguished by its customs)

examples.text: Membros daquela tribo se estabeleceram ao longo do rio.
examples.en: Members of that tribe settled along the river.

examples.text: Algumas tribos indígenas no Brasil estão a ser ameaçadas pelos lenhadores.
examples.en: Some indigenous tribes in Brazil are threatened by loggers.

examples.text: A tribo Zulu da África do Sul tem a sua própria língua.
examples.en: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
